plan.notes: Source: HSU College of Performing Arts and Social Sciences, Psychology (2026-2027 Catalog) PDF, Version 2026/04/03, via the official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index. Header states the plan is 'a suggested program of courses' and 'does not substitute for the HSU catalog'. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 16+15+16+16+15+15+15+12 = 120. The plan prints Sophomore Spring TOTAL as 15, but its five listed courses (Natural Science 4, Developmental/Social Psychology 3, Mental Health Elective 3, PSYC Elective 3, Minor Course 3) sum to 16; the printed plan grand total of 120 is consistent only with the actual sum of 16, so the printed '15' is a catalog typo - kept verbatim, documented here, total_credits uses the sequenced sum. In addition to core courses, all psychology majors complete the ETS Major Field Test in Psychology. The source prints old (pre-2026) course numbers alongside the new ones; new course numbers are used as codes. Junior Spring contains one row rendered as 'PSYC / SW 3103 / PSYC Elective' with the new course number missing in the source; it is treated as a generic PSYC Elective placeholder. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
